FIELD NOTES

Small hero. Big axe.

Explore the garden as our flower-hooded adventurer. Collect all 8 sunstones, smash 12 targets, then return to the glowing shrine.

WASD / arrows — move
Shift — run · Space — throw
Mouse — aim · Click — throw
Q / E or right-drag — rotate camera
R / F — raise / lower camera angle
Scroll — zoom · Esc — close help

On touch screens, use the joystick and Throw. Your axe aims at the nearest target.
